propositions: The outbound mapper injects an assignee resolver via attribute assignment and side-channel discovery rather than explicit parameter passing, causing silent degradation to non-authoritative resolution when injection fails
Attribute injection is invisible to the type checker and hides dead code paths, as demonstrated by the Data Center adapter's missed getattr in PR #120
Two distinct resolver lifecycles exist: core per-issue injection and DC constructor-bound resolver, requiring explicit parameter threading to preserve overwrite semantics
The resolver must be threaded through compute_update_fields and diff_canonical_fields to the resolve_assignee call site, replacing the try/except injection block
The neutral OutboundMapper port signature must be widened with an explicit assignee_resolver parameter to make the dependency contractual and type-checked
